title: Fall Creek strengthens blueberry commitment in southern Chile
summary: Reports which Fall Creek varieties are under validation in southern Chile in 2025: Sekoya Fiesta 'FC13-113', Sekoya Crunch 'FC13-083', Sekoya Grande 'FC13-122', Sekoya Pop 'FCM14-052', ArabellaBlue 'FC14-062', LunaBlue 'FC12-205' and LoretoBlue 'FC11-118', with 'FC15-173', 'FC16-003' and 'FC11-164' listed as selections still in development.
why_it_matters: Names the specific selections a competitor is validating in a specific country, which is a forward indicator of where its genetics will be planted next. Also independently corroborates several brand-to-code mappings.

reading.rationale: A rare public list of which selections are actually in country-level validation.

testing.rationale: Identifies the specific selections that a comparative trial should include.

commercial_position.rationale: Chile is a major counter-seasonal supplier; genetics placement there shapes southern hemisphere supply.

monitoring.rationale: Validation lists change season to season.
